label: Know Your Rights
heading: Know Your Rights
description: Understanding your rights is the first step to protecting yourself and your family.

police.title: When Interacting with Police or Immigration Agents
items: You do not have to answer questions about your immigration status.
You may say: "I want to remain silent."
You have the right to refuse a search without a warrant.
Ask for a lawyer before signing anything.

ice.title: If ICE Comes to Your Home
items: Do NOT open the door without a signed warrant.
Ask to see it through the window or under the door.
You have the right to remain silent.

documents.title: Carrying Documents Safely
items: Avoid carrying your passport unless advised.
Store important documents safely at home.

disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and does not constitute legal advice. For legal assistance, please contact an immigration attorney or an approved legal service provider.
